title: BATWA v2.4.50 Streamlined Clean Personal QR & Identity Display
message: Reverted to classic white P2P QR design, removed dynamic request and clutter, and enhanced personal handle presentation.
features: Clean Personal QR: Classic white card layout with verified badge and high-contrast scanning.
Clutter-Free: Removed redundant dynamic request tabs and bottom payload buttons.
Seamless Scan & Pay Navigation: Quick 1-tap launcher for QR camera scanner.
Preserved Custom Tag & Username: Full identity synchronization across app.
changelog: Reverted My QR Code layout to user-preferred clean white card theme.
Removed Dynamic Amount Request tab and bottom copy payload button as requested.
Fixed QR code screen header visibility with dark contrast title.
